title: Line route (asset overlay)
description: Phase 5a asset overlay kind. The physical route of one authored line: its spans and earth wires are child records. Carried beside the model, never used by the solver: the line's lengthKm, r, x and b stay the authored values.

routeLengthKm.description: Route length, kilometres (the authored lengthKm is not changed by it).

line.description: The authored line this route carries.
